CR - 1. The additional control measures to reduce risks as stated in Risk Assessment Report are implemented.
2. All responsible crew members have been made aware of the defective BWTS and the necessary precautions.
3. The ballast water system (D-1) including the pumps and piping were inspected and found in normal working condition.

Upon completion of above-mentioned inspections, it is recommended that the permanent repair to the Ballast Water
Treatment System to be dealt with as soon as possible but not later than 12 December 2026 granted by the Flag
Administration.
